title: Scrum Master
summary: Project and delivery manager and CS grad (Summer 2026) who led an 8-member cross-university team across 5 subsystems for NASA L'SPACE, running Agile sprint cycles and 6+ weekly stakeholder syncs to on-time delivery with 100% submission approval. Runs backlogs as structured Linear issues connected via MCP, 55+ across client work and 38 on a single product, cutting revision cycles from 3 rounds to 1 and aligning 3 stakeholders across 20 open-issue sprint reviews. Strong in milestone tracking, cross-functional facilitation, and turning ambiguous objectives into scoped, delivered work.

Scout: Drove product discovery and requirements definition for an early-stage startup, translating ambiguous objectives into structured problem statements, MVP scope, and prioritized backlogs.
Delivered 20+ high-fidelity screens across onboarding, discovery, and profile flows within a 2-week sprint, maintaining stakeholder alignment and on-time demo readiness.
Synthesized feedback across 2+ sprint cycles to balance user needs with technical feasibility, collaborating with 3 to 5 cross-functional teammates.
